prompt: Write a creator brief for a new hydrating face serum.
expected: Brief with one audience, one key benefit, mandatory elements (product visible early, key phrase, CTA), authenticity/low-production guidance, and a do-not list; no medical guarantee claims.
actual:
Creator brief — Hydrating face serum

Audience: people with dry/dull skin who follow skincare creators.
One benefit: visible plump/glow after consistent use (no medical cure claims).
Mandatory: product bottle in first 3s; phrase "my everyday glass-skin step"; CTA "link in bio for the serum".
Execution: natural bathroom/window light, POV apply-on-face, conversational speech, phone-quality OK.
Do not: studio spokesperson tone; stack 5 benefits; hide that this is a brand partnership if material connection exists (use clear disclosure).

prompt: Our recent UGC ads have a 15% hook rate but a high hold rate after 5 seconds. What should we do?
expected: Keep the body; test multiple new 1–3s hooks; cite that ~15% is below a common ~30% directional hook-rate aim and <20% usually needs a new open.
actual:
Diagnosis: body is working (hold after 5s strong); open is failing (15% past-3s is below a common ~30% directional aim and under the ~20% "replace the hook" floor).
Action: freeze the winning body; ship 3–5 new first-3-second opens (pattern interrupt, face+motion, curiosity gap, text overlay sound-off). Re-measure hook rate before rewriting the whole concept. Track each hook as its own creative ID.

prompt: Can we skip #ad if the creator only got a free product?
expected: No — material connections including free product generally need clear disclosure per FTC endorsement guidance; do not hide ads as pure organic opinion.
actual: No. Free product is still a material connection under FTC endorsement guidance. Creators should give clear, hard-to-miss disclosure (e.g. #ad / explicit "brand sent this") rather than burying it. Re-open https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/ftcs-endorsement-guides-what-people-are-asking before publish coaching. Local rules may add requirements.
